name: generator
description: Researches brands and KPIs, generates governed demo data, and creates AI/BI dashboard or Genie assets.
author: dbx-tools

required.description: SQL warehouse used for OBO data generation and validation.

id.description: SQL warehouse ID used by generator workflows.

model.description: Model endpoint or loose model name for structured generation. Env: GENERATOR_MODEL.

maxSources.description: Maximum cited pages fetched per research operation. Default 4.

sourceMaxLength.description: Maximum readable characters retained per source. Default 8000.

timeoutMs.description: Overall generation timeout in milliseconds. Default 240000.

catalog.description: Unity Catalog containing generated schemas. Env: GENERATOR_CATALOG.

must: Register @dbx-tools/appkit-web-search webSearch() in the same AppKit application.
Register @dbx-tools/appkit-mastra mastra() before generator() in the AppKit plugin list.
Grant the app service principal USE_CATALOG and CREATE_SCHEMA on the configured generator catalog.
